title: pendingReward view does not simulate post-batch-mint schedule recompute, returns stale values around batch boundaries
description: pendingReward(user) simulates _updatePool forward but does NOT simulate _syncBudget (no pull, no _recomputeSchedule). After a batchMint that bumps latestPrice (and thus would change the schedule on the next state-changing call), pendingReward returns stale numbers compared to what claim() would actually pay. Off-chain integrator/UI inconsistency; no on-chain settlement impact.
recommendation: Either simulate _syncBudget/_recomputeSchedule in the view path, or document pendingReward as a lower-bound estimate that may drift from claim() return values around batch-mint boundaries.
